title: Frequently asked questions by restaurant owners

items.q: Can DineFlow handle separate kitchen and bar order routing?
items.a: Yes! When an order is placed, items configured for the kitchen print to the main kitchen thermal printer, while mocktails, juices, and coffee print directly to the bar station printer with distinct KOT sequences.

items.q: How does split billing and table transfers work?
items.a: Cashiers can easily split bills by seat, item, or equal parts across multiple payment methods (e.g. part cash, part UPI). Guests can also be transferred smoothly between tables without losing order history.

items.q: Does DineFlow work offline if the internet drops?
items.a: Absolutely. The POS Terminal is designed to continue taking orders, firing local kitchen tickets, and printing receipts even during network outages, synchronizing automatically when connectivity resumes.

items.q: Are GST, CGST/SGST, and service charges calculated automatically?
items.a: Yes. DineFlow automatically applies compliant GST (e.g. 5% restaurant GST split into 2.5% CGST + 2.5% SGST) and displays legal tax breakdowns and FSSAI numbers on all printed customer invoices.

items.q: Can we manage recipe costs and raw inventory depletion?
items.a: Yes. Link dishes to ingredient recipes to automatically deplete raw stock (rice, paneer, chicken, dairy) on order completion, and receive alerts when stock falls below reorder thresholds.

items.q: What thermal receipt printers and cash drawers are supported?
items.a: DineFlow supports all standard ESC/POS thermal receipt printers (Epson, TVS, Citizen, Star Micronics) via USB, Ethernet (LAN), and Wi-Fi, along with automatic cash drawer kickouts.
